commit_message: Route AI Studio Build through common ACP runtime
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate common ACP transport, AgentHost bridge, Claude/Codex/Goose adapters
- route first-class AI Studio agent Ask and Build through ACP
- preserve the AgentHost-managed isolated CodeWorkspace for ACP Build sessions
- map ACP permission requests to existing Agent Host approval in desktop and Remote Companion
- parse the existing GameEngine semantic event contract from ACP agent messages and require host completion gates before managed validation
- keep ACP turn-finished distinct from completion, and route Stop/cancel through the bridge

## Integration

Managed Local/Goose selection routing, benchmark migration, Cargo.lock generation, and final validation continue on this Draft integration branch.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required; final integrated-head validation remains authoritative.
